name: Data blue
summary: Blue-led palette with an orange highlight, tuned for charts and tables.
guidance: Body text needs 4.5:1 against its background; large text and UI parts need 3:1.
Every text pair listed here was checked at 4.5:1 or higher.
Use primary-text on primary fills; never put text-secondary on primary.
Keep status meaning in text or an icon too, not color alone.
